fact: The ICT ministry's 2026 budget of 197.335 million dinars, up 7.25% on 2025, was presented to parliament on 24 November 2025 as part of the 2026-2030 development plan and the national digital transition strategy, with 92.910 million dinars of investment commitments.
title: Numérisation, IA et couverture des zones blanches : Le budget TIC 2026 en détails
